architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared UI in src/components/. Neubrutalism CSS via Tailwind. Router: React Router. State: Zustand. No SSR. Mobile-first. Dark mode toggle via CSS vars. Ponytail: no i18n, add when >1 language needed.

tickets.title: Jastip order form page (src/pages/JastipOrderForm.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React. Form fields: item name, quantity, destination, notes. Submit button. Validation: required fields. Error states: inline. Success: toast via Zustand store. Ponytail: no backend integration, mock submit.
acceptance_criteria: Success toast appear after mock submit

tickets.title: Jastip home screen page (src/pages/JastipHome.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Hero banner. Trip catalog grid. Search bar. Badges for trip status. Ponytail: no real data, static JSON in src/mocks/trips.json.

tickets.title: Jastip catalog trip pages (src/pages/JastipCatalogTrip1.jsx, src/pages/JastipCatalogTrip2.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert both Stitch screens. Trip details: images, description, price, available slots. Booking CTA button. Ponytail: no real API, use same mock data as home screen.
acceptance_criteria: CTA button link to order form

tickets.title: Thirtyspace hero section page (src/pages/ThirtyspaceHero.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Hero text. CTA buttons. Background image. Ponytail: no parallax, add when performance stable.
acceptance_criteria: CTA buttons link to respective pages

tickets.title: Thirtyspace login/register page (src/pages/LoginRegister.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Tabs: login, register. Form fields: email, password, name (register only). Validation: required, email format. Error states: inline. Ponytail: no auth backend, mock success.

tickets.title: Thirtyspace 404 page (src/pages/NotFound.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. 404 text. Navigation bento grid. Ponytail: no analytics, add when tracking needed.

tickets.title: Shared UI components (src/components/)
tickets.source_screen: thirtyspace_button_showcase, thirtyspace_badge_showcase, thirtyspace_loader_showcase, thirtyspace_component_showcase_inputs, thirtyspace_sidebar_showcase, thirtyspace_table_showcase
tickets.description: Extract reusable components from Stitch screens. Buttons: primary, secondary, danger. Badges: status, count. Loader: spinner. Inputs: text, textarea, select. Sidebar: collapsible. Table: striped, hover. Ponytail: no theming system, CSS vars for colors.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Navigation bar: logo, menu items, user avatar. Router: React Router. Routes: all pages from TASK-001 to TASK-006. Ponytail: no lazy loading, add when bundle >200KB. Dark mode toggle: CSS vars, Zustand store.
acceptance_criteria: Dark mode toggle persist in localStorage
